notablePrerequisites: Rhys in hand.You control a basic Forest.
description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Rhys by paying {G}.
Rhys enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Rhys, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rhys from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Cat Warrior token, untapping a basic Forest.
Repeat.
